title: Take a screenshot and save it to a file
summary: Capture the entire screen and save the image to a specific file on your Mac. You can also capture just a selected area or include the mouse cursor.

steps.explain: Run the screencapture command followed by the path where you want to save the image. This captures the entire screen.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The full path and filename for the screenshot, e.g., ~/Desktop/screenshot.png

alternatives.explain: Capture only a selected rectangular area of the screen. You will be prompted to drag and select the area.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The full path and filename for the screenshot

alternatives.explain: Capture the entire screen including the mouse cursor.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The full path and filename for the screenshot

alternatives.explain: Capture the screen after a delay (in seconds). Useful for capturing menus or transient UI elements.
